goalDesc: Write one big, clear goal. The app will break it into steps and remind you of it every day.

goalStepsBase: Get crystal clear on what it looks like when this goal is already achieved

Find the smallest possible step you can take today
Notice every moment of belief along the way and write it down
Review your progress once a week and renew your commitment
